title: Flower Granny Square
description: A floral motif square that layers a simple flower center inside a granny-style frame.
expectationText: A motif project that introduces color changes and round-based construction while still ending in a practical square format.

steps.title: Make the center ring
steps.instruction: Start with a magic ring in the flower center color.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Work the center stitches that anchor the flower petals.

steps.title: Round 2
steps.instruction: Create petal groups evenly around the center.

steps.title: Square the motif
steps.instruction: Change color and work corner chain spaces so the flower turns into a square.

steps.title: Add one more border round
steps.instruction: Work evenly around the square to make the edges cleaner and easier to join.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Fasten off and weave in all color-change ends neatly.
